text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Lat pulldown side: 2:1 handle loop plus a 1:1 lat cable

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #5f6368

g.text: Side view of the lat side, seen from inside, to scale. Blue = the same loop as the other side. Orange = the lat cable.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; text-anchor: start
font-size: 8px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; fill: #5f6368

g.text: The loop dips from pulley 2a up over the floating pulley and back down to 2b. Pulling the lat bar lifts the floating pulley, which takes

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; fill: #5f6368

g.text: up 2 units of loop for every 1 unit of lat cable. That lifts the rear trolley 1 unit per unit pulled, so the bar feels the full plate weight.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; fill: #5f6368
